newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat futures end mixed on short covering.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat futures end mixed on short covering.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed mixed and up from their earlier lows on short covering tied to Monday's higher-than-expected USDA wheat export inspection number, traders said.
"The export inspections and the oversold technical conditions conspired to create short covering as people tweaked their positions going into (Wednesday's) USDA crop report," one KCBT trader said.
USDA said 33.588 million bushels of wheat were inspected for export during the week ended Sept 5 -- well above trade expectations for 22.0 million to 26.0 million bushels.
KCBT wheat closed seven cents per bushel lower to 1-1/2 cents higher, with Sept down 1-1/2 cents at $4.49 a bushel. Dec gained 1-1/2 cents to close at $4.47.

Prudential Securities bought 2.5 million March bushels, traders said, while General Mills reportedly bought one million Dec and sold one million March. CIS sold 1.2 million Dec and two million March, sources said.
The KCBT estimated Monday's wheat volume at 32.595 million bushels, above Friday's volume of 27.445 million.
